defaults.title: Quantile class (country-year)
defaults.note: Colors show relative rank for the selected year.

v_dem.note: For most V-Dem indicators here, higher values indicate stronger democratic performance.

rules.note: These V-Dem variants describe model uncertainty or respondent diagnostics, not democratic performance.
V-Dem codes 0 as journalists never daring to offend powerful actors and 4 as journalists never being harassed, so higher values mean less harassment.
V-Dem codes 0 as direct and routine censorship and 4 as the government rarely attempting to censor, so higher values mean less censorship.
V-Dem codes 0 as attacks on the judiciary's integrity carried out daily or weekly and 4 as no attacks at all, so higher values mean fewer attacks.
V-Dem codes 0 as the government disseminating false information extremely often and 4 as never or almost never, so higher values mean less false information.
V-Dem codes 0 as bribery being routine and expected and 4 as it never or hardly ever happening, so higher values mean less bribery.
